title: Research 7/9: failure modes - ossification, circuit splits, forum shopping, and their detection in agent form
description: Research agenda item 7 (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:55). Document how precedent systems ossify (the dead-hand problem), fragment (circuit splits and the mechanisms that resolve them), and get gamed (forum shopping, and the anti-forum-shopping doctrines and venue rules that answer it), plus precedent inflation and citation-cartel dynamics where sources support them. Then design detection for each in agent form. Output docs/precedent-research/07-failure-modes.md. Web research, tagged claims, mandatory implications section.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE (create only this; touch no other file): docs/precedent-research/07-failure-modes.md. Create the parent directory with mkdir -p (idempotent and race-safe: the nine research tasks run in parallel, share no file, and no bootstrap root serializes them). Do NOT create or edit docs/precedent-research/README.md - that index is owned solely by the epic join T-348 (F1 single-owner rule).

WEB RESEARCH IS REQUIRED (coordinator decision D7): at least 5 named sources, of which at least 3 are primary (a judgment with its case name and citation, a statute or code article, an official practice statement or court rule, or a named-author treatise / peer-reviewed article). Every source is listed in a final Sources section with a retrievable identifier (case name plus citation, or URL plus retrieval date). Parametric-only claims with no locatable source are tagged SPECULATION, never ESTABLISHED.

EVERY substantive claim carries exactly one tag: ESTABLISHED (attributable to a named source in the Sources section), ANALOGY (a mapping from legal doctrine onto agent mechanics - the mapping is this agent's inference, not the source's claim), or SPECULATION (neither). An untagged substantive claim is a defect and grounds for REJECT. Basis: roadmap Part V principle 5, no fabricated rigor (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:96).

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Implications for the agent harness': map each finding onto the real substrate by name - blackboard task IDs (T-xxx), the three roles (thinker, worker, verifier) plus coordinator, and the four authority tiers of coordinator decision D4 (1 operator, 2 constitutional, 3 verdicted, 4 single-agent). For each finding state which schema field, CLI subcommand, or protocol rule it demands, or state explicitly that it demands none.

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Extends, does not duplicate': for every doctrine that already has a partial implementation in this repo, cite it by file:line and say whether the finding EXTENDS the existing record or would DUPLICATE it. The candidates the scout already located: note taxonomy DECISION/DEVIATION/TRADEOFF/OPEN-QUESTION (ORCHESTRATION.md:69-77), the reopen verb with its mandatory-reasoning gate (.harness/bin/blackboard.py:470-517, ORCHESTRATION.md:58-67), the P-number ledger (state.json evolution.accepted_mutations), prose P-number citations in ORCHESTRATION.md, recontext.py append-only cited-evidence log, events.jsonl semantic event floor. Rationale: the corpus records a measured non-additive interaction where stacking one more layer that re-does existing verification REGRESSED performance (papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:8, Table 3 RQ3a, '+ system_prompt only' -2.3pp; p.9 'Components interact non-additively').

MANDATORY: state at least one finding that CUTS AGAINST the roadmap brief or the coordinator decision memo where the sources support one. If the sources support none, say so explicitly and say why - a document with zero friction against its own commissioning brief is treated as unverified cheerleading.
NO CODE and NO edits under .harness/ or to PRECEDENT.md. Research tasks have no build dependencies and must create none.

Verification tier: DOC TIER per P-024 (proportional verification) - the verifier does a BRIEF replay (file exists at the exact path; every substantive claim tagged; Sources section present with the required counts; the two mandatory sections present; spot-check that 2 named sources exist), NOT a full adversarial replay. Deep evaluation of research quality happens at the synthesis tasks (T-339 / T-344) and at the epic join (T-348).
Hand off with blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier (never self-mark done). The handoff note must name the 3 findings that most change the schema, each with the tag it carries.

MUST give, for EACH failure mode, a detection design in agent form: the observable signal in the precedent registry or in events.jsonl, the threshold, what a true positive looks like, and what a false positive looks like. This list is consumed directly by T-344 and by the failure-mode section of PRECEDENT.md (T-345).

MUST engage the agent-side analogues the corpus already measured, by file:page: non-additive component interaction where adding one more layer that pushes toward the same verification REGRESSED the aggregate (papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:8 Table 3 RQ3a, '+ system_prompt only' -2.3pp; p.9 'stacking them spends turns on redundant re-checks') as the mechanism of process-over-outcome ossification; and idle-drift, coherent reasoning traces with repeated no-ops and negative net income (papers/coffee_bench.pdf section 5.2, Haiku 4.5) as the behavioural symptom. Tag the mapping honestly - the corpus does not itself claim these are ossification.

MUST address the dead-hand problem in the harness's own terms: the founding premise is that the dead outvote the living (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:5). Say what makes that a feature rather than a defect here, and name the escape valve that keeps it from being a defect (a sunset field, a revisit trigger, a periodic review duty, or an explicit statement that v0 has none).

MUST address forum shopping in the concrete form it can take here: an agent choosing WHICH precedent to cite, or choosing a lineage or engine whose registry lacks the binding record, or re-publishing a decision at a tier where it faces less adversarial process. Name a detectable signal for each.
